{{Top|leg}}
'''Maintenance crawlway B43''' was located on the [[Ithorian Herdship]] ''[[Song of the Clouds]]''. It was used by the [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] [[Hass Sonax]] and [[Dawson (Tynnan)|Dawson]] to access a secure [[lockbox]] containing a [[Gun of Command]] during a [[Heist on the Song of the Clouds|heist]]. While in the crawlway, Sonax used her [[Borg Construct Aj^6]] to disable [[containment field 776]] surrounding the lockbox, while Dawson used a [[Fusioncutter/Legends|fusioncutter]] to cut through the wall of the crawlway into the lockbox.<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|The Great Herdship Heist}}</ref>
